limitations: The example concerns automated driving, not an LLM.
Human and organizational failures contributed alongside the deployed system.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AI need not be superintelligent to create serious problems; the real issue is control.

statement.excerpt: you don’t have to be superintelligent to create serious problems.The real issue is control.
statement.document_title: A CERN for AI and the Global Governance of AI

from_speaker: you don’t have to be superintelligent
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that AI below superintelligence can cause substantial harm, and inadequate safeguards or oversight can materially contribute.
Serious problems includes death or serious injury.
Control includes technical safeguards and human or organizational oversight. I do not read the statement as saying that control is the sole cause of every AI harm.
Assess documented examples existing before the post, rather than imposing a forecast deadline.
criteria.support_condition: An investigated incident establishes serious harm involving a specialized AI system and identifies inadequate safeguards or oversight as a contributing cause.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes that the proposed examples did not involve serious harm or non-superintelligent AI, or that the attributed control failures did not contribute. Failure of individual examples alone would not disprove the general possibility claim.
